main_text.p: iugo se vltro, summiserint Principes, Populiue, digni profecto sint qui seruiant: Istuc vt trahi posse sperent terrae dominos? (omnes mehercle liberi lubentius fumus quam seruimus; nedum Reges) aut ex aduerso, hoc qualecunque iuris remissuros Ecclesiae tyrannos? Nugae! Nam & illi icti sapiunt; & hi iamdiu, quod de Georgio Satrapa Arriano Ruffinus, procaciter vi raptum Episcopatum gerunt, vt qui magis sibi iuris dicendi creditos fasces, quam sacerdotium ministrandum religiosis officijs æstiment.Ruff.l.1.c.23.

page.notes: The marginal note "Ruff.l.1.c.23." is printed in italic in the left margin. Signature "SECT·" at the foot right is a catchword-style mark. Some letters in the running head and text are blurred; readings are best effort.
